resources.string: Switching audio quality disconnects the earbuds for a few seconds while they reconnect.
High-quality audio doesn\'t work with 3D audio. Turning it on turns 3D audio off, and the earbuds will disconnect for a few seconds.
3D audio doesn\'t work with high-quality audio. Turning it on switches to standard quality, and the earbuds will disconnect for a few seconds.

QuickBuds is only tested on OnePlus Buds 4. If something does not work on your buds, use Settings › Report a problem. Nothing is sent until you tap Send.

Records how long your earbuds are connected. The data stays on this phone.
QuickBuds keeps each connection for this long. After that, it keeps only the daily totals, so the week and month charts stay correct.
Warns you when the signal to your earbuds keeps getting weaker.
High warns sooner, at a stronger signal. Low warns later and gives fewer false alarms. Walls and your body also weaken the signal.
Not available: this phone cannot read the signal strength of these earbuds.

Hold your phone steady for a second.
Slow down a little: move slowly so the signal can follow.
You\'re getting closer. Keep going slowly.
Getting weaker. Turn around and try another way.
No change for a while. Walk a few steps in another direction.

No clear direction. Turn once more, away from walls.
The direction comes from your turn: your body blocks the signal from behind. It is an estimate.
This phone has no compass, so there is no arrow. Use the radar.
Rings at 1, 5, 10, 20 and 30 m. The ring or the dot shows the estimated distance.
No direction yet: turn in a circle on the Arrow tab to place the dot.

At this time QuickBuds stops the audio and disconnects every Bluetooth audio device: earbuds, neckbands, headphones, speakers. Disconnected earbuds and speakers then switch off by themselves after a few minutes.

Asks the question in your earbuds and listens once. No call is touched.
unclear: auto-answer answers if it is on, or the phone keeps ringing
English replies work best. Tamil words are often unclear offline. Then auto-answer answers if it is on, or the phone keeps ringing. It never guesses.
Works only with earbuds connected for calls, never on the phone\'s speaker. Your reply is recognised on the phone: nothing is sent online. A number that is not in your contacts gets no question.
Voice answer needs phone (to see a call), call logs (the number), contacts (the name), microphone (your reply), and answering calls. Allow them in the app\'s permissions.
Bike mode turns on what you choose here, from this screen or the quick settings tile. When you turn it off, your settings from before come back.

Listens only while Bike mode is on and earbuds are connected. It always uses the earbuds\' microphone, the only one that hears you on a bike. While it listens, music plays in call quality: earbuds cannot play music and use their microphone at the same time. It stops during calls. Speech is recognised on the phone: nothing is sent online.
